    StartersHakuna Matata chakalakaSmoky South African relish of peppers, carrot, beans and chilli, with charred breadHow to make it2 tbsp vegetable oil1 brown onion, diced2 garlic cloves, crushed1 tbsp grated ginger1 red capsicum, diced1 green capsicum, diced2 carrots, grated1 long red chilli, chopped2 tsp mild curry powder1 tsp smoked paprika400g tinned diced tomatoes400g tinned baked beans1 Turkish loaf1 bunch corianderSoften the onion in the oil with the garlic, ginger and chilli.Add the capsicums and carrot and cook 5 minutes.Stir in the curry powder and paprika, then the tomatoes and baked beans. Simmer 15 minutes until thick.Slice and char the bread on a hot grill pan. Serve with the chakalaka, warm or at room temperature, and scatter with coriander.Rafiki's fruitMango, papaya, pineapple and passionfruit with lime, chilli salt and mintHow to make it2 mangoes1/2 papaya1/4 pineapple2 passionfruits1 lime1 pinch chilli flakes1 bunch mintCut the mangoes, papaya and pineapple into wedges.Lay on ice with the passionfruit pulp.Squeeze over lime and sprinkle with chilli salt and torn mint.Pride Rock apricot lamb sosatiesA nod to Southern African street foodHow to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb cubes marinated overnight in apricot jam, curry and vinegar, skewered with dried apricots and onion, grilled sticky and charred.Mix 3 tbsp apricot jam, 1 tbsp mild curry powder, 2 tbsp vinegar, 1 grated onion and salt.Toss with 800g diced lamb leg and marinate overnight.Thread onto 8 skewers with 100g dried apricots and wedges of 1 onion.Grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning and brushing with the leftover marinade, until charred and just pink inside.Biltong and droëworsStrictly beef. Pumbaa checked twice.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsPride Lands bobotieSouth African spiced beef bake with curry, chutney and an egg custard toppingHow to make it2 slices of white bread300ml full cream milk800g beef mince1 brown onion1 tbsp curry powder1 tsp ground turmeric2 tbsp mango chutney2 eggs3 bay leavesSoak the bread in some of the milk and chop the onion.Fry the mince with the onion, curry powder and turmeric.Stir in the chutney and the squeezed bread, then press into a dish.Beat the eggs with the remaining milk and pour over. Add bay leaves and bake at 180°C.Lioness hunt peri peri chickenNala and the lionesses bring home dinnerHow to make itAs written, serves 4Butterflied chicken marinated in charred chilli, garlic, lemon and paprika, roasted until crackling, with yellow rice and a cooling mango salsa.Blitz 2 red chillies (seeded for kids), 4 garlic cloves, the juice of 1 lemon, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 60ml oil and salt.Rub over a butterflied 1.8kg chicken and marinate overnight.Roast at 220°C for 45 minutes until 75°C in the thigh.Cook 300g rice with half a tsp turmeric.Dice 1 mango with red onion, coriander and lime for salsa.SweetsTimon's grub chocolate mousseChocolate mousse with crushed cookie dirt, gummy worms and a mint leafHow to make it150g dark chocolate2 eggs150ml thickened cream100g chocolate biscuits1 bag gummy worms1 bunch mintMelt the chocolate and cool slightly, then whisk in the egg yolks.Whip the cream and the egg whites separately, then fold into the chocolate.Spoon into four cups and chill.Top with crushed chocolate biscuits, gummy worms and a mint leaf.Zazu's morning report mandaziCardamom coconut doughnut triangles, fried and dusted with icing sugarHow to make it400g plain flour7g dried yeast80g caster sugar1 tsp cardamom250ml coconut milk2 L vegetable oil50g icing sugarMix the flour, yeast, sugar, cardamom and warm coconut milk into a soft dough.Rest the dough.Roll out and cut into triangles.Fry at 170°C in the oil in batches until puffed and golden.Dust with icing sugar.DrinksPride Rock punchMango, pineapple and passionfruit punch topped with lemonade and limeHow to make it400ml mango nectar400ml pineapple juice3 passionfruits500ml lemonade1 limecrushed ice, to serveMix the mango nectar, pineapple juice and passionfruit pulp.Pour over crushed ice in four glasses, top with lemonade and squeeze in some lime.Mango and baobab smoothieZazu brings it with the morning report.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
